title: fix: tidy the image cards and tag visits by page
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Sign-in links on the image and text free-limit pages now use separate `ref` tags, `legacy-image` and `legacy-text`, so Enter can distinguish visits from each page. The image limit card now says “1 free image every 45 seconds,” and the model card says “Sign in to use it,” removing outdated “Classic API” wording across their square, tall, and wide images.

Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny painter’s beret and stays small-to-medium in the scene, with flowers, a warm cream and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
